backgroundImage.longCaption: Kevin O'Brien celebrates the wicket of Omer Hussain, Ireland v Scotland, ICC World Cricket League Division 1 final, Amstelveen, July 10, 2010

items.html:
Cousin of Majid Haq, the Scotland allrounder with whom he grew up in Hunterhill, Hussain has worked his way up the Scotland youth sides and made his full international debut against Ireland at Ayr in August 2006. Like his cousin, he has had problems with his weight which has prevented him playing more internationals though, by mid-2006, he appeared to have worked his way to a better state of fitness. In 2007, he was called up to Scotland's squad for their Intercontinental Cup match against UAE.
Will Luke June 2007
